purpose: Comparator records for NYSC COURSE-026 Field Assistant (agricultural). The governed catalogue publishes no module headings for this course, so the records are shown without a competency matrix. Records describe documented curriculum only and do not establish equivalence, quality or labour demand.
status_note: No record has been human-verified yet. Every record must be checked against its official source by a researcher before publication.

country_group_gaps.developed: No developed-economy field-crops comparator with sufficiently specific core content was verified on 2026-10-18: Australia's AHC30122 Certificate III in Agriculture was inspected but not used because its only core units are generic (workplace health and safety; sustainable work practices), with all technical content elective.

records.duration_as_published: One Year (1200 Hours + 150 Hours OJT/Group Project)

modules.title_verbatim: Identify metrological instruments and the diversity within the profession of horticulture following safety precautions.
Plan and prepare life cycles of plants, scope of horticulture and introduction to fruits, flowers & vegetables.
Classify fruits and vegetables based on season and edible parts.
Install agro-meteorology instruments, analyze metrological data and record the data.
Identify, select and maintain different farm power machinery.
Measure physical and chemical properties of soil, soil pH, different methods and ingredient use for correction of Acid soil.
Plan, install and use different irrigation systems, Water lifting systems and water quality assessment systems.
Identify different types of soil, methods of soil sampling and collection, study on soil physical characters, Interpret soil test reports and different soil correction methods.
Analyse Soil water holding capacity, Different methods and ingredients used for correction of Saline soil. Field visit for identification of soil problems.
Plan and execute different soil correction method through drainage and agronomic practices.
Measure soil fertility and apply soil fertility management for improvement of fertility of soil.
Apply Integrated Nutrient Management System (INMS) in the field.
Identify, prepare and apply Bio-fertilizers.
Identify the role of major and minor plant nutrients and its deficiency symptoms.
Produce different types of fruits, vegetables and flowers as per the requirements.
Apply various cultivation techniques & methods to fruit crops & vegetable farms.
Plan and execute different garden layouts and designs.
Identify and select different Vegetative propagation method & use of plant hormones.
Apply propagation techniques viz cutting, grafting, budding and layering.
Process and preserve vegetables and fruits using different techniques to prepare jam, jelly, squash, sauce, pickle, ketchup etc. its preservation and storage.
Develop the Cultivation techniques of different vegetables and spice crops.
Perform Floriculture and cultivation techniques for different Flowers, Climbers, Foliages and Medicinal plants to decorate
Perform Cultivation of Betel Vine and Mushroom farming.
Apply Pest Management and control the Pest and Diseases of Horticultural Crops.
Use techniques of Seed Production, Processing and Packaging.
Maintain the records viz. Inventory Control, Maintenance of Records and Store management.
Conduct Market Survey and follow the legal requirement for trading as part of entrepreneurship development.
